answer: Written in a long technical clauses, numbers at the end register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the onyx of a task receipt, and the meadow is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on optimistic execution with fraud proof windows. Reaching the dune of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
